signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 3 US offices
1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Own conversion on Truemed.com . Run a steady stream of A/B tests across landing pages, product pages and the marketplace, and turn the results into product decisions.
Build new shopping experiences. Work with engineering and design to ship new ways for customers to find and buy products.
Grow the marketplace. Improve how products are listed, merchandised and discovered, for customers and merchant partners alike.
Connect marketing, product and engineering. Work hand in hand with marketing so that bringing people to the site and turning them into customers run as one funnel. Share data…
Own the metrics. Set success metrics with leadership across discovery, click-through, purchase and revenue, and size the revenue impact of every win.
Own the end-to-end merchant experience: from developer onboarding and API integration through payment operations, revenue reconciliation, dispute management, and merchant…
Own the developer platform roadmap: API design, documentation, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that reduce time-to-first-sale
Partner with engineering to design and ship platform integrations (Shopify, direct API, and emerging channels)
Serve as the voice of the merchant — synthesizing feedback from sales, merchant support, and direct merchant conversations into a prioritized roadmap
Define success metrics for merchant health (time to first sale, NRR, merchant NPS) and instrument the systems needed to track them
